text:
mina: Quick heads-up — our GPU commitment horizon ends 04/30 for a bunch of SKUs (p4d, p4de footprints). Need a sensitivity sweep for coverage vs usage before we lock any new commits.

jorge: Which accounts/regions are highest risk? EMEA or us-west-2?

mina: us-west-2 and eu-west-1 top of list. Dedicated pools for inference are mostly in us-west-2. EMEA has some spot-heavy training fleets.

rachel: I'll run tag-by-model usage and prefix-KV cache impact. Want outputs by: avg daily hours, 95th pct, peak day and unallocated capacity.

samir: I'll model traffic shifts if we enable quantization rollout (may drop GPU hours ~15-20%). Also sim traffic growth scenarios + new customer onbaording spikes.

lee: If we're flexible on family, convertible RIs or savings plans that cover multiple instance types might help. Also staggered commits (50/50 across quarters) reduces risk.

mina: Agree. Main asks:
- coverage delta if we reduce commit by 20/30/50%
- cost impact vs on-demand/spots
- operational risk to Dedicated SLAs

rachel: I'll share a CSV by EOD. starting query now.

samir: Quick cost query sample for anyone replicating (AWS Cost Explorer):
```
aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --time-period Start=2025-03-01,End=2025-03-31
aws ec2 describe-reserved-instances --filters Name=state,Values=active
# or Athena: SELECT product_instance_type, sum(usage_amount) FROM cost_report WHERE usage_type LIKE '%p4d%' GROUP BY product_instance_type;
```

jorge: I'll reach out to AWS rep about p4d exchange window and ask about exchange fee/lead time.

costbot: CostBot: Weekly RI/SavingsPlan utilization snapshot uploaded to /wiki/costs/ri-snapshots/2019-03-.. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

rachel: Found ~12% idle on p4d pool in eu-west-1 (nightly). If we schedule model retraining to daytime we can recover ~5%.

lee: Also check Dedicated autoscale grace settings — some idle shows as 'allocated' but usage zero due to long drain.

mina: Action items:
- rachel: coverage CSV + recommended commit sizes (by SKU + by region) — due EOD.
- samir: sensitivity scenarios (quant rollout, +25% growth, -20% demand) — due 2d.
- jorge: vendor/rep ask and convertible RI feasibility — due 48h.
- lee: ops risk note + suggested stagger plan + fallback to on-demand — due 48h.

mina: Thx all. We'll meet 2pm tomorrow to decide commit % and finalize purchase window.

rachel: pinging @eng-finance when CSV is up.

samir: adding a note — if we commit too aggressively we can always sell/convert but there's often a timing slippage risk.

lee: +1. prefer flexible mix rather than all-in on p4d. :white_check_mark:

mina: closing loop — please drop interim updates in this thread. 👍
